evals.prompt: Add a test that fails the build if a core module imports from any feature module in this KMP project
expect: chooses Konsist (not ArchUnit/Detekt) and explains why for KMP
uses Konsist.scopeFromProject().files filtered to production source
keys the rule on the on-disk module path, not package names only
shows how to verify the rule actually bites (plant a violation, watch it go red)

evals.prompt: Why not ArchUnit for this Kotlin Multiplatform module-boundary check?
expect: explains ArchUnit reads compiled bytecode, which a commonMain/iosMain KMP source set never hands a JVM test task
Konsist reads source from disk, so it sees every source set

evals.prompt: Enforce that a feature's api module never imports its own impl
expect: filters production files whose module path is feature/**/api
asserts no import is both under the feature package and contains .impl.
does not over-engineer api-to-impl pairing helpers when packages encode the module

evals.prompt: My architecture test passes but I'm not sure it's actually checking anything
expect: warns that a misfiltered rule can select zero files and pass forever
recommends the planted-violation bite test and a permanent non-empty-scope guard

evals.prompt: Where should the Konsist test live and how do I run it?
expect: places it in one JVM test source set (conventionally the app module)
